tool_input.content:
WITH
lab AS (SELECT account_id, label_time, churned FROM labels_fg_1),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, label_time, amount, balance FROM (
    SELECT l.account_id AS account_id, l.label_time AS label_time, x.amount AS amount, x.balance AS balance,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY x.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM lab l JOIN transactions_fg_1 x
      ON x.account_id = l.account_id AND x.event_time <= l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
pr AS (
  SELECT account_id, label_time, credit_score, tier FROM (
    SELECT l.account_id AS account_id, l.label_time AS label_time, x.credit_score AS credit_score, x.tier AS tier,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY x.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM lab l JOIN profiles_fg_1 x
      ON x.account_id = l.account_id AND x.event_time <= l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
ac AS (
  SELECT account_id, label_time, sessions_7d FROM (
    SELECT l.account_id AS account_id, l.label_time AS label_time, x.sessions_7d AS sessions_7d,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY x.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM lab l JOIN activity_fg_1 x
      ON x.account_id = l.account_id AND x.event_time <= l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
he AS (
  SELECT account_id, label_time, health_score FROM (
    SELECT l.account_id AS account_id, l.label_time AS label_time, x.health_score AS health_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.account_id, l.label_time ORDER BY x.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM lab l JOIN account_health_fg_1 x
      ON x.account_id = l.account_id AND x.event_time <= l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  l.account_id,
  l.label_time,
  tx.amount,
  tx.balance,
  pr.credit_score,
  pr.tier,
  ac.sessions_7d,
  he.health_score,
  l.churned
FROM lab l
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = l.account_id AND tx.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN pr ON pr.account_id = l.account_id AND pr.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN ac ON ac.account_id = l.account_id AND ac.label_time = l.label_time
LEFT JOIN he ON he.account_id = l.account_id AND he.label_time = l.label_time
ORDER BY l.account_id
